estimands.meta_d_descriptor: oracle-among-known-families value on standardized utilities; >0 in population iff Delta_f not all one sign; NOT a test statistic and NOT evidence of signature learnability

mechanistic_hypotheses.H_mech_2: smooth families (Branin, Hartmann, SixHumpCamel) lose model-guided budget to extra design points

predeclared_rules.futile: not detected AND all CI half-widths < 0.25 * sd_f (precise null)

interaction.null: Delta_1 == ... == Delta_F (no family x config interaction)

lofo_sign_prediction.caveat: no resolution at F=5 with a near-even split; descriptive only

mechanistic_sign_test.role: secondary corroboration of the predeclared directional hypotheses; does not enter the conditionality rule
